the major capsid protein YP_167486.1 was also abundantly detected in the co-culture with Synechococcus sp. WH8102 (Results, p5)

Notable in the co-cultures was the complete absence of PaxA (YP_165496.1). This RTX-like toxin represents over 50% of the total exoproteome of R. pomeroyi DSS-3 when grown in optimal laboratory conditions (Results, p5)

The flagellin protein YP_168655.1 represented 37.5% of the global proteome. These motility proteins had previously been shown to have an important role in the lifestyle of D. shibae DFL-12 [15] (Results, p7)
